bullets.text: Continue to manage and oversee institutional client portfolios across the firm's equity and multi-asset platform alongside strategist responsibilities.

Produce portfolio reviews with full Brinson-Fachler attribution, sleeve decompositions, and episode-level narratives tied to verified market events for endowments, foundations, and institutional mandates.
Support defensive growth and multi-asset mandates with attribution verification, performance narrative, and client-facing analytical responses.
Lead introductory strategy presentations and deeper technical follow-ups with portfolio managers for pensions, endowments, foundations, sovereign institutions, and consultants.

Authored or significantly contributed to two dozen client-facing written deliverables in the last nine months: meeting preparation, post-meeting response packages, bespoke analytical answers, and consultant-ready research.
Deliver quarterly strategy commentary and symposium scripts; guest lectures at Duke University with prior presentations at MIT and Oxford.

Built a connected research program on market structure and active management: where active risk is rewarded, whether track records are statistically distinguishable from luck, and how benchmark concentration has changed the opportunity set.

Authored papers on tracking-error decomposition, small-cap market structure, Korea discount repricing, and active-versus-passive dynamics across five equity universes; several taken through compliance to external distribution.
Wrote rapid-response macro and geopolitical notes during the early-2026 escalation, grounding headlines in market transmission mechanics.

The objective is not faster workflows alone. It is reimagining how institutional sales would run in a fully data-driven ecosystem: research surfaces interesting anecdotes and competitive pain points; conversations trigger prepared follow-up materials; opportunities map to the asset owners and consultants most likely to care.
Built an anomaly-discovery pipeline over a frozen manager-universe dataset to surface marketable manager pain points as ranked candidates for notes and targeted outreach.
Developed consultant-channel intelligence across major consulting firms, combining hand-curated coverage maps with CRM history analysis to identify relationship white space.

Designed and implemented institutional AI-enabled platforms: Investment Process Demo (model transparency and portfolio traceability) and Sales AI Platform (market analysis, agentic commentary, competitive intelligence).
Built restriction-intelligence monitoring for values-based mandates, a document formatting and compliance pipeline, and a research-library publishing system with no deploy step.
Codified writing-voice and agent skills so drafts arrive closer to final; packaged attribution, screening, and publishing as repeatable workflows rather than one-off automation.

Led quantitative research and portfolio management across commodities, multi-asset, and global equity strategies. Managed up to $8B in multi-asset portfolios at peak and contributed to broader platform growth reaching tens of billions in AUM during expansion phase.
Designed scalable stock-level risk parity framework incorporating multidimensional risk allocation constraints; reduced portfolio construction runtime from hours to seconds.
Architected Defensive Equity platform spanning U.S., International, Small Cap, and Emerging Markets strategies.
Designed and launched Defensive Growth suite in 2019; transitioned framework to incorporate bottom-up stock selection while preserving risk architecture.
Published nine external research papers and 100+ internal research memoranda.
Raised $700M+ independently across defensive equity and defensive growth strategies.
Led commercialization efforts including client presentations, consultant engagement, and strategy positioning.
Defensive Growth International strategy outperformed benchmark by approximately 5% in 2025.

role: Quantitative Research Analyst | Long-Short Small Cap

bullets.text: Developed quantitative factors and portfolio construction enhancements within a ~$400M U.S. small-cap long-short strategy.

Designed portfolio optimization constraint to maximize differentiation from common institutional factor exposures using fund holdings data, factor crowding metrics, and market microstructure intelligence.
Architecture materially reduced unintended beta exposure during systemic stress. In 2008, the strategy delivered approximately flat performance and ranked at the top of its peer group.
Directed enterprise systems architecture and development teams (30+ direct reports) across distributed, middleware-driven platforms.
Designed distributed inventory intelligence framework for large retail network operating under intermittent connectivity constraints.
Implemented scalable document digitization and retrieval systems for financial and insurance institutions.
Contributed to certification design and technical standards for enterprise imaging middleware.
